It was a great experience. The service was very good the waiters spoke English. The meal was delicious in French. It’s true that the tartiflette made an eye out for us and frankly we feasted, I think it’s the first time since we’ve been in Asia, that when we ask for our starter with drinks, we really have our starter with drinks, because otherwise each time we have everything at the same time. So no frankly the the service very well we are very happy, we recommend 100% And besides really not very expensive, an establishment to put in your list for your visit to Sapa.
